name.value: Floating island variant (moored, tropical waters; Q-030, Q-031)

latitude_deg.note: generic tropical mooring within the ocean-thermal band; the parcel is a mooring decision, not a land parcel

elevation_m.note: sea-level datum; the deck freeboard is a hull-design output, not a site input

g_m_s2.note: standard gravity; local gravity at the study site differs by about 0.1 %

pressure_Pa.verification_test: Site barometric pressure for the station elevation (ASHRAE climatic design conditions, AQS-SITE-002 [B1]); the study uses the standard atmosphere

composition_mole_fraction.units: mole fraction, dry air, rounded to four places

vent_sink.register: AQS-SITE-002 (open site; vents and stacks discharge to outside air)

oxidant.note: air carries O2 at the composition above

cooling_dry_bulb_C.verification_test: Metocean record at the mooring site; the interim tropical maritime value is replaced per A-M-389

heating_dry_bulb_C.verification_test: Metocean record at the mooring site; heating is not governing in the tropical band

insulation_ambient_C.verification_test: Sea-surface temperature record at the mooring site

pv_yield_kWh_kWp_d.verification_test: PVWatts run at the mooring latitude with marine soiling and cell-temperature losses; deck area limits the nameplate (AQS-PLAN-011 section 10.2)

night_hours.verification_test: Hourly load and irradiance profile at the mooring latitude

basic_wind_speed_m_s.units: m/s basic wind speed (Saffir-Simpson Category 5 survival on the moorings)
basic_wind_speed_m_s.verification_test: Class environmental load method with site metocean data (CLASS_RULES); the ride-out strategy (Q-031) makes the design storm the survival case

seismic.not_applicable: Offshore moored platform: wave, wind and mooring loads per the class environmental method govern; seismic ground motion does not apply (AQS-PLAN-011 section 10.2)

ground.not_applicable: No ground contact at a floating site: the hull structure and moorings follow the class rules (CLASS_RULES); earthing is to the sea through the hull with cathodic protection

radiation.not_applicable: Earth surface under the atmosphere: natural background only, no shielding design case

value.name: seawater_surface
value.composition_note: salinity 35.165 g/kg; sodium 10.78, chloride 19.35, magnesium 1.284, bromide 0.067 g/kg; lithium about 0.18 mg/kg
value.treatment: reverse-osmosis desalination (least energy 1.06 kWh/m3 at 50 % recovery, DESAL_MIN_ENERGY); the reject brine feeds salt, magnesium, bromine and lithium recovery, each needing an assay feed case (AQS-PLAN-011 section 10.2)

value.name: precipitation
value.note: tropical rain is a bonus, not a designed source; the intake is the designed make-up

value.name: seawater_surface
value.composition_note: salinity 35.165 g/kg; sodium 10.78, chloride 19.35, magnesium 1.284, bromide 0.067 g/kg; lithium about 0.18 mg/kg
value.treatment: reverse-osmosis desalination (least energy 1.06 kWh/m3 at 50 % recovery, DESAL_MIN_ENERGY); the reject brine feeds salt, magnesium, bromine and lithium recovery, each needing an assay feed case (AQS-PLAN-011 section 10.2)

value.name: precipitation
value.note: tropical rain is a bonus, not a designed source; the intake is the designed make-up

feed_cases.register: AQS-PLAN-011 section 10.2 (candidates: seawater minerals - salt, magnesium, bromine, lithium - floating plastic debris, seaweed and ship-delivered waste; each enters only after mapping to an assay case)

arrival_mode.value: ship berth with cranes; transfers limited by sea state
arrival_mode.verification_test: Berth design and the weather-window study set the hold times (AQS-PLAN-011 section 10.2)

resupply_interval_d.units: d between berths, weather window pending
resupply_interval_d.verification_test: Weather-window study at the mooring site; the interval sets store hold times

ac_frequency_Hz.units: Hz line frequency (IEC 60034-30-1 60 Hz IE3 basis, AQS-INV-005)

earthing_method.value: hull as earth electrode with sea return and cathodic protection
earthing_method.note: no soil; the grounding study reruns for a sea-return geometry

code_families.register: AQS-PLAN-011 section 10.2 (class rules, SOLAS, MARPOL, the MODU code as the model for a manned floating installation, and the intact stability code; the flag or coastal state decides which apply, Q-030)

heel_deg.verification_test: Metocean data and the class environmental load method, with model tests

roll_deg.verification_test: Metocean data and the class environmental load method, with model tests

pitch_deg.verification_test: Metocean data and the class environmental load method, with model tests

heave_m_s2.verification_test: Metocean data and the class environmental load method, with model tests

packed_bed_rule.value: bed height two to three column diameters; packing-height margin 1.1 to 2.0
packed_bed_rule.note: applies to every packed column of the variant (X-LOC-11 design pass)

value.register: AQS-DUTY-012; Q-024 (sources chosen per site); deck area limits the nameplate (AQS-PLAN-011 section 10.2)

sources.register: AQS-PLAN-011 section 10.2 (wave and ocean thermal are flagged options, entered where the site supports them and their sizing exists)

storage.register: AQS-PLAN-011 section 10.2: pumped hydro on a hull has little head and costs stability, so it is eliminated with ZNBR2 plus the hydrogen bank and fuel cell as the different-technology storage pair

oversize_factor.units: PV nameplate / PV needed to close the daily balance
oversize_factor.verification_test: NSRDB hourly run for the mooring band plus the deck-area limit
oversize_factor.register: A-M-109 (deck area limits the nameplate; AQS-PLAN-011 section 10.2)

value.register: AQS-PLAN-011 section 10.2: pumped hydro on a hull has little head and costs stability; ZNBR2 with the hydrogen bank and fuel cell is the different-technology storage pair
AQS-PLAN-011 section 10.2: seawater-source heat exchange through the DRY_COOLER pair (mode seawater) replaces the ground loop
AQS-PLAN-011 section 10.2: seawater-source heat exchange on the Q4 loop (DRY_COOLER seawater mode) replaces the ground-loop heat pump
the seawater rejection pair is the second heat-rejection source after the ground loop is gone (redundancy rule)

buoyant_separation.register: AQS-SITE-002; gravity.g_m_s2 above zero, steady in direction (fixed foundation)

air_heat_sink.register: AQS-SITE-002; open site; cooling design dry bulb AQS-SITE-002

ground_contact.register: AQS-SITE-007; a floating hull has no ground: the ground loop and soil-bearing functions are replaced or eliminated

liquid_water_at_ambient.register: AQS-SITE-002; atmosphere.pressure_Pa above the triple point of water
liquid_water_at_ambient.note: seawater at 28 C at the surface (SEAWATER_MILLERO); the seawater heat-rejection mode and any evaporative charge draw from it

value.register: AQS-PLAN-011 section 10.2 (seawater exchangers replace the dry cooler; deep cold water where the intake reaches it also serves ventilation)
